purpose: Establish a mass-conservative moving-water-table geometry oracle and quantify the published-average-state algebra discrepancy before any BC2 reduced dynamics.

authorities.source_2021: He et al. 2021 Journal of Hydrology 602:126797
authorities.source_2022: He et al. 2022 Journal of Hydrology 613:128327
authorities.source_2026: He et al. 2026 Hydrological Processes e70396
authorities.source_code_record: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.17613977; record public, files restricted at preregistration time

tests: analytic polynomial moving-control-volume identity under arbitrary smooth theta(z,t) and H(t)
stage_A1_algebra_gate.hard_rule: BC2-CONSERVATIVE must satisfy the analytic identities to floating-point tolerance. BC2-PUBLISHED-THETA is reported diagnostically and is not selected by fit.

stage_A2_reference_geometry.role: fixed-domain Richards profile used only as a full-order geometry oracle
stage_A2_reference_geometry.material: B01 Mualem-Van Genuchten, same hydraulic authority as RS1-GW

profile.coordinate: SWAP z negative upward-coordinate convention internally; reported H is positive depth below surface
profile.initial_pressure_head_rule: h(z) = -H0 - z, with z in cm relative to surface elevation 0
profile.initial_state: hydrostatic interior zero-pressure crossing; lower profile saturated

histories.role: head step favoring shallower equilibrium water table
head step favoring deeper equilibrium water table

geometry_observation.H_definition: positive depth H=-z_wt where z_wt is the strict interior linear zero-pressure crossing between adjacent Reference nodes
geometry_observation.crossing_rule: same linear interpolation geometry as mod_b110_smooth_freatic_projection; policy restriction bottom_mode==2 is not bypassed or relabeled as canonical projection
smoothness_gate: one and only one strict negative-to-positive pressure-head crossing
geometry_observation.theta_s_rule: B01 saturated water content from frozen constitutive parameters
geometry_observation.moving_unsaturated_storage_cm: U_ref = W_total - theta_s*(D-H), valid only while all Reference nodes strictly below the zero crossing are saturated to constitutive theta_s within floating-point tolerance
geometry_observation.water_table_flux_reference: q_H is identified with the fixed-bottom through-flux only after the saturated-zone storage audit verifies theta=theta_s below H and no source/sink exists in the saturated zone
geometry_observation.no_direct_equivalence: bottom prescribed pressure head is never used as H; H is diagnosed from the accepted full profile

reference_ledger.source_sign: depth and q positive downward for BC2 reporting
reference_ledger.expected_identity_over_interval: Delta U_ref = Q_top_down - Q_H_down + theta_s*Delta H
geometry_ledger_report: max absolute interval moving-unsaturated ledger residual
max absolute cumulative moving-unsaturated ledger residual
max saturated-node theta departure from theta_s

BC2_CONSERVATIVE.geometry_input: diagnosed H(t) and finite-difference dH/dt from the frozen Reference trajectory
BC2_CONSERVATIVE.authorization: only after A2 geometry ledger qualifies

BC2_PUBLISHED_THETA.authorization: may be executed on identical frozen H(t) only after A2 qualifies

adjudication.rule: A2 must qualify a smooth interior water-table geometry and moving-volume ledger before any reduced moving-water-table dynamics are admitted.
